unit_goal_source.description: Exact ready contract/path and baseline used for the current unit.

unit_residuals.description: Current PR/slice contract clauses not covered at this checkpoint. Any entry blocks the slice.

goal_residuals.description: Frozen run-goal clauses still open after this honest slice. They require continuation but do not block this slice.

goal_complete.description: True only when goal_residuals is empty and end-to-end goal acceptance is proven.

coverage.description: One row per enumerable obligation of the unit: every contract `## Fault matrix` line, every Acceptance/Parity clause, every public API entry point the diff adds or changes, every frozen oracle/golden artifact the contract references.

row.description: Obligation, quoted or tightly paraphrased from its source.

status.description: pass: a committed RED discriminates it (a plausible wrong implementation fails); weak: a carrier exists but a named plausible wrong implementation passes while violating the obligation as declared (lossy/inexact assertion, non-discriminating fixture, absent count/order/identity check) — a mutant beyond the declared clause/failure-model row is a concern, not weak; missing: no carrier.

citation.description: file:line of the carrier, or of the obligation source when missing.

note.description: Why weak/missing, referencing the backing finding; empty for pass.

axes.description: One entry per rifty-review rubric axis, in rubric order.

authority.description: For blockers: the violated DECLARED authority — exact contract clause, repo rule (AGENTS.md/docs/process), active ADR, or named baseline behavior. A blocker without one is invalid. Empty for concern/nit.
